name: Rupiah Token
oneLiner: IDRT is PT Rupiah Token Indonesia's centralized rupiah stablecoin, backed 1:1 by IDR bank deposits and KYC-gated for direct issuance and redemption.
collateral: Indonesian rupiah bank deposits held 1:1 by PT Rupiah Token Indonesia; issuer materials describe full fiat backing with regular bank reporting
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 issuance and redemption through PT Rupiah Token Indonesia after KYC; the issuer publishes bank-reporting and smart-contract audit materials

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Rejected-redo re-review 2026-07-30 from scratch: IDRT is issuer-minted natively on Ethereum, BSC, and Polygon — on each chain the token is a non-upgradeable Ownable ERC20 whose owner() is PT Rupiah Token Indonesia's 4-of-6 Safe (re-verified on-chain 2026-07-30 at Ethereum block 25648595, BSC block 113088269, Polygon block 91163184; identical 6-owner signer set and threshold 4 on all three chains), so there is no bridge minter on those chains; Across remains only a liquidity/intent transfer path for canonical tokens. The Harmony deployment is a legacy '1IDRT' lock-mint representation minted by a Harmony bridge contract (re-verified minter 0xbadb6897... at Harmony block 92211006) and dormant since 2021.

routes.reviewNote: Re-verified from scratch on-chain 2026-07-30 at Ethereum block 25648595 (ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, corroborated by eth.drpc.org): name 'Rupiah Token', symbol IDRT, totalSupply 44,876,696,516.00; non-upgradeable (EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots both zero); owner() = 0x109046f16d512843138218f061232f2cc7d7c9d7 — a Safe proxy with getThreshold() = 4 and getOwners() = the documented 6-owner set. Mint is the issuer Safe's native owner path, not a bridge. Home chain.

Re-verified from scratch on-chain 2026-07-30 at BSC block 113088269 (bsc-rpc.publicnode.com): name 'Rupiah Token', symbol IDRT, totalSupply 31,739,108,295.00; non-upgradeable (EIP-1967 slots zero); owner() = 0x0e8b655e51d8166dad044f45f22e8d4eff652ea4 — a Safe proxy, getThreshold() = 4, identical 6-owner signer set as the Ethereum Safe. Issuer-native mint, no bridge representation.

Re-verified from scratch on-chain 2026-07-30 at Harmony block 92211006 (api.harmony.one): symbol '1IDRT' (legacy Harmony bridge naming), totalSupply 1,201,000.00 (approx. USD 72); the 2026-07-20 note's '1,200,000.00' was rounding — a historical-block bisect confirms totalSupply was already 1,201,000.00 at the prior probe block 91745490, so no new issuance has occurred. The token has no owner() but exposes mint/isMinter/addMinter; isMinter(0xbadb6897cf2e35aca73b6f37361a35eeb6f71637) = true; that contract's owner() = EOA 0x533334823b1e5a9c17b32b2957660e84b4d3cfad (0-byte code via eth_getCode). The minter set is not enumerable on-chain, so additional minters cannot be excluded; last token activity 2021-10-29 and last owner call to the minter contract 2022-10-16 — the legacy Harmony bridge is dormant.

Re-verified from scratch on-chain 2026-07-30 at Polygon block 91163184 (polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com): name 'Rupiah Token', symbol IDRT, totalSupply 14,040,000,000.00 (6 decimals); non-upgradeable (EIP-1967 slots zero); owner() = 0xa1f0fc535ad0ebcae0ef81b2990fcd75465ad7ae — a Safe proxy, getThreshold() = 4, identical 6-owner signer set as the Ethereum Safe. Issuer-native mint, no bridge representation.

mintAuthority.summary: IDRT is a non-upgradeable Ownable ERC20 on Ethereum, BSC, and Polygon. On all three chains the token owner() is the same 4-of-6 Safe multisig (same six signers cross-chain). The owner() controls mint and burn. Harmony is excluded from this assessment (chain inactive).

controls.label: PT Rupiah Token Indonesia — 4-of-6 Safe (Ethereum)
controls.evidence: Re-verified 2026-07-20: at Ethereum block 25571083, IDRT (0x998ffe...) owner() = 0x109046f16d512843138218f061232f2cc7d7c9d7 (171-byte Safe proxy; getThreshold() = 4; getOwners() = 6 EOAs: 0xf18c1ca6..., 0x41fad55c..., 0x031f9a3c..., 0xed4e4310..., 0x3dd6ea51..., 0xf042bfbd...). At BSC block 111014993 owner() = 0x0e8b655e51d8166dad044f45f22e8d4eff652ea4 (171-byte Safe proxy, threshold 4, identical 6-owner set). At Polygon block 90540824 owner() = 0xa1f0fc535ad0ebcae0ef81b2990fcd75465ad7ae (171-byte Safe proxy, threshold 4, identical set). Prior review (Ethereum block 25295025, 2026-07-15) established Safe v1.3.0, no modules, no guard, and non-upgradeable Ownable ERC20 tokens on all three chains; owner() controls mint and burn. Harmony excluded (legacy bridge representation, dormant — see bridgeRouteRisk).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, BSC block 103628780, Polygon block 88323921: IDRT is a non-upgradeable Ownable ERC20 on each chain. Owner is a 4-of-6 Safe (v1.3.0) with identical signer set across Ethereum (0x109046f...), BSC (0x0e8b655...), and Polygon (0xa1f0fc5...) — all 6 EOA signers match. No modules or guard on any Safe. Harmony deployment excluded (chain is inactive). No proxy; no separate minter role. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): Johannes Juara & Rekan issued a monthly agreed-upon-procedures report for 2026-01-31, signed 2026-02-09, but the expected subsequent monthly reports are absent as of 2026-07-15; current recurring reconciliation is therefore not established. Bappebti crypto-asset recognition and trading oversight do not constitute prudential supervision of PT Rupiah Token Indonesia as a stablecoin issuer.
